item.title: SHAFT 0.69.0
item.description:
• Settings → Server keys now shows on a Mac paired with its own server over the tailnet (it was hidden unless paired at 127.0.0.1). Needs the server's loopback path on (SHAFT_WEB_LOCAL).
  • The Mac app's update window shows these notes directly, not only a link.
  • Closing an empty thread no longer asks to end a conversation.
  • The promises and corrections gauges count from the supervisor's own copy of the ledgers, so a row the instance later edits or removes still counts.

Full release notes
